Script.name: DG Control - anti-idle
Script.script: -- DG Control :: anti-idle -- The game warns at 5 minutes and then every minute after 10 ("inactive for N minutes"). -- Answer it with a harmless command (dg.ctl.cfg.idleCmd, default "look"). -- Toggle with: antiidle on|off dg = dg or {} if dg._antiIdleTrig then killTrigger(dg._antiIdleTrig) end dg._antiIdleTrig = tempTrigger("you have been inactive for", function() local C = dg.ctl if C and C.cfg and C.cfg.antiIdle == false then return end send((C and C.cfg and C.cfg.idleCmd) or "look", false) cecho("\n<128,128,128>[dg] anti-idle: sent '" .. ((C and C.cfg and C.cfg.idleCmd) or "look") .. "'<reset>\n") end)

Script.name: DG Control - auto logging
Script.script: -- DG Control :: auto-start logging -- Starts Mudlet's session log when the profile connects (and right away if already connected). -- To turn this off for one profile, untick this script. dg = dg or {} function dg.autoLog() if dg._autoLogged then return end dg._autoLogged = true local ok, a, b = pcall(startLogging, true) if ok and a then cecho("\n<128,128,128>[dg] logging started: " .. tostring(b) .. "<reset>\n") end end if dg._autoLogH then killAnonymousEventHandler(dg._autoLogH) end dg._autoLogH = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysConnectionEvent", function() tempTimer(2, dg.autoLog) end) if (getNetworkLatency and getNetworkLatency() or 0) > 0 then tempTimer(1, dg.autoLog) end

Script.name: DG Control - loops (data)
Script.script:
-- DG Control :: loops (data only) -- -- This is the one place combat-loop PATTERNS still live as Lua data, because a loop watches -- for several lines of game output and reacts to each -- that's genuinely too much to make -- into separate native triggers. Everything else (aliases, single commands, keys) is now a -- native Mudlet object you can browse in the Aliases/Keys tabs. -- -- dg.ctlLoops[name] = { start = first command, rules = { {pattern, command} ... }, -- stop = { pattern | {pattern, command} }, qc = send "q c" first, -- target = false for loops with no target } -- {t} = current target, {me} = your character name, '*' in a pattern = wildcard. -- A loop name that means something different per character uses: -- dg.ctlLoops[name] = { by_class = { raptorian = {...}, kressa = {...} } } -- -- dg.ctlData.chars: character name -> archetype key (used by dg.ctl.class and by any alias -- that branches per character, e.g. bolt, cloud). dg.ctlData.classKits: same, but keyed by -- the game's GMCP class name, for a character not listed by name yet. -- -- Save this script after editing and everything rebuilds itself.
dg = dg or {} dg.ctlData = dg.ctlData or {} local D = dg.ctlData
D.chars = { raptorian = "raptorian", kressa = "kressa", tarvi = "tarvi", nyvar = "nyvar", }
-- Optional: pick an archetype by class (from the game's GMCP status) for a character not -- listed above. The login line prints the class it sees, e.g. "char: Nyvar class: Cleric -- archetype: nyvar" -> add cleric = "raptorian" here so Nyvar's spells resolve like Raptorian's. D.classKits = { -- cleric = "raptorian", }
-- lines that end any targeted loop, for every character dg.ctlStops = { "but the*is dead", "I don't see what you are referring to" }
-- weapon / punch rules shared by killing, beat and throwing local weaponRules = { { "You swing your", "k {t}" }, { "you throw your* at ", "throw spiked at {t}" }, { "you're too close", "k {t}" }, { "you must move closer to your opponent's rank", "k {t}" }, } local beatRules = { { "You kick at", "kick {t}" }, { "You punch at", "punch {t}" }, { "You cannot do that when both your hands are full.", "kick {t}" }, { "you must move closer to your opponent's rank", "punch {t}" }, }
-- Stealth trainers. stealth("sneak") -> ptsneak, stealth("hide") -> pthide. -- ptsneak: hide until hidden, then: adv 1 until the front wall, ret, ret to the back, repeat. If -- revealed at any point: q c, hide until hidden, resume where it left off. -- Kressa / Katie / Kasper also keep SHADOW SLINKING up (the spell you memorized as "sneak", cast with -- invo sneak): cast first, and again whenever "The shadows cease to guide your movements" shows. -- The cast reveals you, so the loop hides again afterwards. It waits out the cast using the -- "[N sec. delay]" the game prints, so a changed casting time needs no edit here. -- pthide: hide until hidden, then un-hide with ' (never "reveal": that drops disguises), then hide again. -- Both: when fatigue runs out the loop rests, then carries on (see startRest below). -- Only ONE command is ever in flight (the game's type-ahead queue is tiny and ret has a 3s delay), -- so every command waits for the game's answer to the last one. Any "[N sec. delay]" line pushes the -- "no reply" watchdog out by that long, so a long cast never looks like a stall. local function stealth(kind) local SNEAK = (kind == "sneak") local NAME = SNEAK and "ptsneak" or "pthide" local SLINK_CHARS = { kressa = true, katie = true, kasper = true } -- who keeps shadow slinking up (ptsneak only) local CFG = { hide = "hide", adv = "adv 1", ret = "ret", -- pthide un-hides with a single ' (the game answers "Say what?" and you step out of hiding). -- NEVER use the "reveal" command here: it also drops your disguise. unhide = "'", rest = "rest", stand = "stand", -- what to send when worn out / to get going again restResume = 0.8, -- get going again once a "** Current fatigue: X out of Y" line shows this fraction restMax = 120, -- ...or after this many seconds of resting, whichever comes first -- Heal trip: when you run out of fatigue, walk to the healer, heal and walk back, then carry on. -- Room numbers are your map's. Each step is a command to send or a mapper walk to a room; the trip -- stops the loop (and tells you where you are) if a walk does not end in the expected room. With -- no mapper, or a map that does not know where you are, it just rests. Set trip.from to a room -- number to make the trip happen only when you are standing there. trip = { enabled = true, from = nil, -- nil = from anywhere low = 8, -- go when a "Current fatigue" line shows this much or less out = { { walk = 184 } }, -- the healer's hut heal = "shop heal", -- retried while the game says you are still in combat back = { { walk = 11933 } }, -- where training carries on stepWait = 2.5, -- seconds after each plain command walkMax = 90, -- give up on one walk after this long healTries = 8, healWait = 4, }, cast = "invo sneak", -- the shadow slinking spell castDelay = 20, -- fallback wait if the game's "[N sec. delay]" line is missed maxCasts = 3, -- give up casting after this many tries with no "shadows guide" reply maxFizzles = 5, -- ...but casts the game interrupts ("runes fly apart") are retried up to this many times fizzleWait = 2, -- seconds to wait before retrying an interrupted cast rets = 2, -- ret commands per trip to the back delay = 0.3, -- pause after a game line before the next command retDelay = 3.3, -- ret carries a 3 sec delay; wait it out stall = 10, -- seconds of silence (after any game delay) before it re-evaluates and resends } local S = { on = true, hidden = false, mode = "adv", retLeft = 0, clear = false, useSlink = SNEAK and SLINK_CHARS[tostring(dg.ctl.char or ""):lower()] == true, slink = false, casting = false, castSeen = false, casts = 0, fizzles = 0, warned = false, busyUntil = 0, resting = false, trip = nil } local timer, watchdog, restTimer
local function now() return (getEpoch and getEpoch()) or os.time() end
local function timersOff() if timer then killTimer(timer); timer = nil end if watchdog then killTimer(watchdog); watchdog = nil end end
local step -- defined below
-- (Re)start the "no reply" watchdog. It waits CFG.stall seconds PLUS whatever game delay is still -- running, so an 18 second cast (or a 3 second ret) is never mistaken for a stall. local function armWatchdog() if watchdog then killTimer(watchdog); watchdog = nil end local wait = CFG.stall + math.max(0, S.busyUntil - now()) watchdog = tempTimer(wait, function() watchdog = nil if S.on then S.casting, S.castSeen = false, false dg.ctl.say(NAME .. ": no reply for " .. CFG.stall .. "s, retrying"); step(0) end end) end
local function fire(cmd) if S.clear then S.clear = false; dg.ctl.send("q c") end dg.ctl.send(cmd) armWatchdog() end
-- Schedule one command. A newer call replaces a pending one, so a burst of lines from a -- single action (e.g. reveal + the move it interrupts) still produces a single command. local function queue(cmd, wait) if not S.on then return end timersOff() timer = tempTimer(wait or CFG.delay, function() timer = nil if S.on then fire(cmd) end end) end
step = function(wait) if not S.on then return end if S.resting or S.trip then return end -- worn out (resting / off to the healer); those resume us if S.casting then return end -- a cast is in flight; its "[N sec. delay]" line resumes us if S.useSlink and not S.slink then if S.casts < CFG.maxCasts then S.casting, S.castSeen, S.casts = true, false, S.casts + 1 dg.ctl.say(NAME .. ": casting shadow slinking (try " .. S.casts .. ")") queue(CFG.cast, wait) return elseif not S.warned then S.warned = true dg.ctl.warn(NAME .. ": shadow slinking did not take after " .. CFG.maxCasts .. " casts; training without it (halt and start again to retry)") end end if not S.hidden then queue(CFG.hide, wait) elseif not SNEAK then queue(CFG.unhide, wait) elseif S.mode == "adv" then queue(CFG.adv, wait) else queue(CFG.ret, wait) end end
-- Out of fatigue: stop sending anything, rest, and resume when fatigue is back up. local function endRest(why) if not S.resting then return end S.resting = false if restTimer then killTimer(restTimer); restTimer = nil end dg.ctl.say(NAME .. ": done resting (" .. why .. "), carrying on") dg.ctl.send("q c") dg.ctl.send(CFG.stand) step(1.5) end
---------------------------------------------------------------- heal trip -- which room the mapper has us in (Mudlet's own player room first, then the generic mapper's) local function mapRoom() local r = getPlayerRoom and getPlayerRoom() if not r or r < 0 then r = map and map.currentRoom end return tonumber(r) end
local function tripCleanup() local T = S.trip if not T then return end if T.timer then killTimer(T.timer); T.timer = nil end if T.guard then killTimer(T.guard); T.guard = nil end if T.handler then killAnonymousEventHandler(T.handler); T.handler = nil end end
local function tripAbort(why) tripCleanup() S.trip = nil dg.ctl.warn(NAME .. ": heal trip failed (" .. why .. "); the map thinks you are in room " .. tostring(mapRoom() or "?") .. ". Stopping.") dg.ctl.loopStop("heal trip failed") end
local function tripNext(i) local T = S.trip if not T or not S.on then return end local st = T.steps[i] if not st then tripCleanup() S.trip = nil dg.ctl.say(NAME .. ": back from the healer, carrying on") S.hidden = false step(1.5) return end local function after(w) T.timer = tempTimer(w, function() T.timer = nil; tripNext(i + 1) end) end
if st.cmd then dg.ctl.send(st.cmd); after(CFG.trip.stepWait)
elseif st.walk then -- send your own walkto command, then watch the mapper until it says we are there if mapRoom() == st.walk then after(0.5); return end dg.ctl.say(NAME .. ": walkto " .. st.walk) expandAlias("walkto " .. st.walk) local t0, seen = now(), 0 local function poll() T.timer = nil if mapRoom() == st.walk then seen = seen + 1 else seen = 0 end if seen >= 2 then tripNext(i + 1); return end -- there, and still there a second later if now() - t0 > CFG.trip.walkMax then tripAbort("the walk to room " .. st.walk .. " did not end there"); return end T.timer = tempTimer(1, poll) end T.timer = tempTimer(2, poll)
elseif st.heal then T.healTries = 0 local function try() T.healTries = T.healTries + 1 if T.healTries > CFG.trip.healTries then tripAbort("could not heal after " .. CFG.trip.healTries .. " tries"); return end T.healing, T.busy = true, false dg.ctl.say(NAME .. ": " .. CFG.trip.heal .. " (try " .. T.healTries .. ")") dg.ctl.send(CFG.trip.heal) T.timer = tempTimer(CFG.trip.healWait, function() T.timer = nil if T.busy then try() else T.healing = false; tripNext(i + 1) end end) end try() end end
local function startTrip() local steps = {} for _, s in ipairs(CFG.trip.out) do steps[#steps + 1] = s end steps[#steps + 1] = { heal = true } for _, s in ipairs(CFG.trip.back) do steps[#steps + 1] = s end S.trip = { steps = steps } S.casting, S.castSeen, S.hidden = false, false, false timersOff() dg.ctl.say(NAME .. ": out of fatigue -- off to the healer") dg.ctl.send("q c") tripNext(1) end
local function startRest() if S.resting or not S.on then return end S.resting, S.casting, S.castSeen, S.hidden = true, false, false, false timersOff() dg.ctl.say(NAME .. ": too tired -- resting (back to work at " .. math.floor(CFG.restResume * 100) .. "% fatigue, or after " .. CFG.restMax .. "s)") dg.ctl.send("q c") dg.ctl.send(CFG.rest) restTimer = tempTimer(CFG.restMax, function() restTimer = nil; endRest("timed out") end) end
-- Out of fatigue: the healer trip when we are in the practice room and the mapper can walk, else rest. local function exhausted() if S.resting or S.trip or not S.on then return end local TR = CFG.trip local why if not (TR and TR.enabled) then why = "heal trip is switched off" elseif not mapRoom() then why = "the mapper has not told Mudlet which room you are in" elseif TR.from and mapRoom() ~= TR.from then why = "the map says room " .. tostring(mapRoom()) .. ", the heal trip starts from room " .. tostring(TR.from) end if not why then startTrip(); return end dg.ctl.say(NAME .. ": no heal trip (" .. why .. ")") startRest() end
-- A retreat answer counts even if we were just revealed (the move still happens). local function retDone() if S.mode ~= "ret" then return end S.retLeft = S.retLeft - 1 if S.retLeft <= 0 then S.mode = "adv" end step(CFG.retDelay) end
local def = { target = false, qc = true, start = function() step(0) end, onStop = function() S.on = false; timersOff(); tripCleanup(); S.trip = nil; if restTimer then killTimer(restTimer); restTimer = nil end end, rules = { -- hiding { "you slip into the shadows", function() S.hidden = true; step() end }, { "you are already unable to be seen", function() S.hidden = true; step() end }, { "you fail in your attempt to hide", function() S.hidden = false; step() end }, { "you reveal yourself", function() S.hidden = false; S.clear = SNEAK; step() end }, -- worn out: rest (the game says one of these when fatigue is gone) { "warning: current fatigue below", exhausted }, { "don't have enough energy to do that", exhausted }, { "too exhausted to keep up", exhausted }, -- the game prints "** Current fatigue: X out of Y" now and then: enough to get going again? { "current fatigue:*out of", function() local cur, max = (line or (getCurrentLine and getCurrentLine()) or ""):match("[Cc]urrent fatigue:%s*(%d+)%s*out of%s*(%d+)") cur, max = tonumber(cur), tonumber(max) if not (cur and max and max > 0) then return end if S.resting then if cur / max >= CFG.restResume then endRest(cur .. "/" .. max .. " fatigue") end elseif not S.trip and CFG.trip and cur <= CFG.trip.low then exhausted() end end }, -- something attacked us: stop rather than keep poking at a game that refuses { "you can't do that while in combat", function() if S.trip then if S.trip.healing then S.trip.busy = true end -- still fighting: the healer will be asked again else dg.ctl.loopStop("in combat") end end }, -- the game bounced a command: try again in a moment { "type-ahead queue full", function() step(2.5) end }, -- any "[N sec. delay]": remember it so the watchdog waits it out; a cast also resumes from here { "sec. delay", function() local n = tonumber((line or (getCurrentLine and getCurrentLine()) or ""):match("(%d+)%s*sec")) if n then S.busyUntil = now() + n end if S.useSlink and S.casting and S.castSeen then S.castSeen = false -- anything else already waiting in the game's queue (a stray second cast, extra hides) -- would run the moment the delay ends, so clear it now dg.ctl.send("q c") -- hold until the cast is over, THEN decide (the "shadows guide" line arrives at the end) timersOff() timer = tempTimer((n or CFG.castDelay) + 2, function() timer = nil; S.casting = false; step(0) end) elseif watchdog and n then armWatchdog() end end }, }, }
if SNEAK then local walk = { -- walking to the front { "you advance another", function() if S.mode == "adv" then step() end end }, { "you cannot advance further", function() if S.mode == "adv" then S.mode, S.retLeft = "ret", CFG.rets; step() end end }, -- going to the back { "you retreat", retDone }, { "you may not retreat any further", retDone }, } for _, r in ipairs(walk) do def.rules[#def.rules + 1] = r end end
if S.useSlink then local more = { -- a cast finished (the "[N sec. delay]" rule above takes it from here) { "weaving those runes cost you", function() if S.casting then S.castSeen = true end end }, -- the spell is up / still up / gone -- the cast was interrupted ("The summoning of this spell was interfered with by what you have -- readied!"): the FPs are gone but no spell. Try again soon; these don't count toward maxCasts. { "the runes quickly fly apart after being called", function() if not S.casting then return end S.fizzles = S.fizzles + 1 S.casts = math.max(0, S.casts - 1) S.casting, S.castSeen = false, false timersOff() if S.fizzles > CFG.maxFizzles then S.casts = CFG.maxCasts dg.ctl.warn(NAME .. ": the cast was interrupted " .. CFG.maxFizzles .. " times in a row; training without shadow slinking (halt and start again to retry)") step(0) else dg.ctl.say(NAME .. ": cast interrupted, retrying (" .. S.fizzles .. ")") step(CFG.fizzleWait) end end }, { "the shadows seem to guide your movements", function() S.slink = true; S.casts = 0; S.fizzles = 0 end }, { "keeping up the shadow slinking on yourself", function() S.slink = true; S.casts = 0 end }, { "already seems to be a spell of that type", function() S.slink = true; S.casting = false; step() end }, { "the shadows cease to guide your movements", function() S.slink = false; S.casts = 0; step() end }, } for _, r in ipairs(more) do def.rules[#def.rules + 1] = r end end return def end
-- Disguise loops. disme FIELD VALUE keeps trying until "info disguise" shows it took; ptdis FIELD VALUE -- keeps disguising (to train the skill) until you halt. The goal comes from dg.ctl.disgGoal, set by the -- disme / ptdis aliases (dg.ctl.cmdDisme / cmdPtdis). After every attempt it sends "info disguise" and -- reads the answer: "You are disguised as Ferrets Down, a Female San Elf Thief." local function disguiseLoop(train) local NAME = train and "ptdis" or "disme" local G = (dg.ctl.disgGoal and dg.ctl.disgGoal.fields) or {} local ORDER = { "name", "race", "sex", "class" } local CFG = { gap = 5, -- disme: seconds between attempts while it has not taken yet trainGap = 60, -- ptdis: seconds between training attempts (what your own training used) stall = 10, -- no "info disguise" answer for this long (plus any game delay): try again } local S = { on = true, tries = 0, ok = {}, busyUntil = 0 } local timer, watchdog local function now() return (getEpoch and getEpoch()) or os.time() end local function off() if timer then killTimer(timer); timer = nil end if watchdog then killTimer(watchdog); watchdog = nil end end
-- "You are disguised as Ferrets Down, a Female San Elf Thief." local function parse(txt) local nm, sex, rest = tostring(txt or ""):match("[Yy]ou are disguised as (.-), an? (%a+) (.+)$") if not nm then return nil end return { name = nm, sex = sex:lower(), rest = (rest:gsub("[%s%.]+$", "")):lower() } end local function has(info, f, v) v = tostring(v):lower() if f == "name" then return info.name:lower() == v end if f == "sex" then return info.sex == v end if f == "race" then return info.rest:sub(1, #v) == v end -- "san elf thief" starts with "san elf" if f == "class" then return info.rest:sub(-#v) == v end -- ...and ends with "thief" return false end
local attempt local function schedule(wait) off() wait = math.max(wait, S.busyUntil - now() + 0.3) timer = tempTimer(wait, function() timer = nil; if S.on then attempt() end end) end
attempt = function() S.tries = S.tries + 1 for _, f in ipairs(ORDER) do local v = G[f] if v and (train or not S.ok[f]) then dg.ctl.send("disguise " .. f .. " as " .. v) end end dg.ctl.send("info disguise") if watchdog then killTimer(watchdog) end watchdog = tempTimer(CFG.stall + math.max(0, S.busyUntil - now()), function() watchdog = nil if S.on then dg.ctl.say(NAME .. ": no answer from info disguise, trying again"); attempt() end end) end
local function answered() if watchdog then killTimer(watchdog); watchdog = nil end local info = parse(line or (getCurrentLine and getCurrentLine()) or "") if not info then schedule(CFG.gap); return end -- "You are not disguised." or unreadable: go again local all = true for _, f in ipairs(ORDER) do local v = G[f] if v then if has(info, f, v) then S.ok[f] = true else S.ok[f] = nil; all = false end end end local now_ = info.name .. ", " .. info.sex .. " " .. info.rest if train then dg.ctl.say(NAME .. ": attempt " .. S.tries .. " done -- now " .. now_) schedule(CFG.trainGap) elseif all then dg.ctl.say(NAME .. ": done after " .. S.tries .. " attempt(s) -- you are " .. now_) dg.ctl.loopStop("disguised") else dg.ctl.say(NAME .. ": not yet (attempt " .. S.tries .. ") -- you are " .. now_ .. "; trying again") schedule(CFG.gap) end end
return { target = false, start = function() attempt() end, onStop = function() S.on = false; off() end, rules = { { "you are disguised as", answered }, { "you are not disguised", answered }, { "type-ahead queue full", function() schedule(2.5) end }, { "sec. delay", function() local n = tonumber((line or (getCurrentLine and getCurrentLine()) or ""):match("(%d+)%s*sec")) if n then S.busyUntil = now() + n end end }, }, } end
dg.ctlLoops = {
------------------------------------------------------------ generic (every character) killing = { qc = true, start = "k {t}", rules = weaponRules }, beat = { qc = true, start = "punch {t}", rules = beatRules }, thk = { qc = true, start = "throw spiked at {t}", rules = weaponRules },
-- First aid on yourself: fame. Sends treat {me} and sends it again every time the game -- says "You tend your wounds." {me} is whatever setme says, so a disguised character -- just does setme <disguise name> first. halt / F4 stops it. fame = { target = false, start = "treat {me}", rules = { { "You tend your wounds.", "treat {me}" } }, }, -- First aid on someone else: fa NAME (fa me = fame). Same idea, aimed at NAME. It deliberately -- does not use the kill target, so NAME is not painted as your enemy. fa = { target = false, start = function() dg.ctl.send("treat " .. (dg.ctl.faTarget or "")) end, -- PROVISIONAL wording: confirm what the game prints when you treat someone else rules = { { "You tend *'s wounds", function() dg.ctl.send("treat " .. (dg.ctl.faTarget or "")) end } }, stop = { "I don't see what you are referring to" }, },
autohide = { target = false, start = "hide", rules = { { "you fail in your attempt to hide", "hide" } }, stop = { "you slip into the shadows" }, },

disme = { target = false, make = function() return disguiseLoop(false) end }, -- disme name Ferrets Down ptdis = { target = false, make = function() return disguiseLoop(true) end }, -- ptdis name Ferrets Down

------------------------------------------------------------ Kressa spk2 = { -- fire / air / earth fist cycle qc = true, start = "invoke fire {t}", rules = { { "{me}'s hand begins to glow with white-hot flames", "invoke airfist {t}" }, { "Swirling mist begins to gather around {me}'s clenched fist", "invoke efist {t}" }, { "Particles of earth rise from the ground and surround {me}'s fist", "invoke fire {t}" }, }, }, ppk = { -- pickpocket practice qc = true, start = "pickpocket {t}", rules = { { "You must move closer to your opponent's rank to engage in combat.", "pickpocket {t}" }, { "You blow your pickpocket attempt", "pickpocket {t}" }, { "You grab a coinpurse from", "pickpocket {t}" }, { "You fumbled that pickpocket attempt!", "pickpocket {t}" }, }, stop = { "Your target is staring right at you!" }, }, pl = { -- pick a lock until it opens start = "picklock {t} with lock", rules = { { "You fail to pick the lock.", "picklock {t} with lock" } }, stop = { "With a click, you succeed!" }, }, ptpl = { -- pick, open, close, repeat (lockpick training) start = "picklock {t} with lock", rules = { { "You fail to pick the lock.", "picklock {t} with lock" }, { "With a click, you succeed!", "open {t};close {t};picklock {t} with lock" } }, },

(The old DGR elemental cycle is no longer here; v0.19 still has it.) kressa = { qc = true, start = "invoke dart {t}", rules = { -- printed once per cast, only to you, whatever name you are wearing (so a disguise can't break it) { "Weaving those runes cost you", "invoke dart {t}" }, { "you're too close", "invoke dart {t}" }, { "you must move closer to your opponent's rank", "invoke dart {t}" }, }, },

The cue lines are copied from Kressa and NOT verified for Nyvar -- -- if spk stalls after the first cast, send a cast transcript and the cue gets fixed. nyvar = { qc = true, start = "invoke dart {t}", rules = { { "Weaving those runes cost you", "invoke dart {t}" }, { "you're too close", "invoke dart {t}" }, { "you must move closer to your opponent's rank", "invoke dart {t}" }, }, },

Script.name: DG Control - engine
Script.script:
-- DG Control :: engine -- Aliases, triggers and keys are now native Mudlet objects (Aliases / Triggers / Keys tabs, -- organized in folders you can browse, edit and enable/disable yourself). This script is the -- small shared library they call into: character detection, the "loop until it's dead/gone" -- engine, highlight painting, and a couple of one-line helpers so a native alias's own script -- stays short. You should not need to edit this file for day-to-day changes -- edit the alias, -- trigger or key itself instead.
dg = dg or {} dg.ctl = dg.ctl or {} local C = dg.ctl C.version = "0.39"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- config (dgcfg in game) --------------------------------------------------------------------------- C.cfg = C.cfg or {} local defaults = { highlights = true, -- the colour rules in the highlights script (off = leave colouring to the HUD) panels = "auto", -- Thoughts + Arrivals floating windows. auto = on, unless the Dragons Gate HUD is installed gagArrivals = true, -- pull "just arrived / has left the world" out of the main window (only when panels are on) gagChat = false, -- also pull thoughts/tells out of the main window (only when panels are on) antiIdle = true, -- answer the 5-minute inactivity warning idleCmd = "look", showSends = false, -- echo every command sent (debugging) } for k, v in pairs(defaults) do if C.cfg[k] == nil then C.cfg[k] = v end end
C.rgb = { alert = {255, 85, 85}, speech = { 85, 255, 85}, speechDim = { 40, 150, 40}, -- darker green for say/ask/exclaim lines, so friend names (speech) stand out inside them soft = { 85, 255, 255}, move = {255, 85, 255}, key = {255, 255, 85}, dim = {170, 170, 170}, orange = {255, 165, 0}, blue = { 90, 140, 255}, wound = {200, 95, 95}, gold = {230, 190, 120}, -- closest friends/family: distinct from whisper/affection (soft/cyan) scarlet = {255, 20, 147}, -- worst enemies: distinct from the many other red ("alert") line rules temp = {200, 255, 0}, -- temporary highlights (tl): lime, not used by anything else }
C.ids = C.ids or {} C.targets = C.targets or {} C.me = C.me or nil C.class = C.class or nil
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- small helpers --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local function trim(s) return (tostring(s or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")) end local function reEsc(s) return (s:gsub("[%^%$%(%)%.%[%]%+%-%?%{%}%|\\%*]", "\\%0")) end -- zMUD-style glob: '*' = anything, everything else literal local function glob(s) return (reEsc(s):gsub("\\%*", ".*")) end C.glob = glob
local function curLine() return line or (getCurrentLine and getCurrentLine()) or "" end
function C.say(msg) decho("\n<255,255,85>[dg]<r> " .. msg .. "\n") end function C.warn(msg) decho("\n<255,85,85>[dg]<r> " .. msg .. "\n") end
function C.track(group, kind, id) if id then C.ids[group] = C.ids[group] or {} table.insert(C.ids[group], { kind, id }) end return id end
function C.kill(group) for _, e in ipairs(C.ids[group] or {}) do local kind, id = e[1], e[2] if kind == "trigger" then pcall(killTrigger, id) end end C.ids[group] = {} end
function C.trig(group, rx, fn) local ok, id = pcall(tempRegexTrigger, rx, fn) if not ok or not id then C.warn("trigger failed: /" .. rx .. "/ " .. tostring(id)); return nil end return C.track(group, "trigger", id) end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- helpers a native ALIAS's own tiny script can call --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- dg.ctl.send(cmd) -- a single command, honouring the showSends debug setting function C.send(cmd) cmd = trim(cmd) if cmd == "" then return end send(cmd, C.cfg.showSends) end
function C.sendAll(list) for _, c in ipairs(list or {}) do C.send(c) end end
function C.split(s) local out = {} for part in tostring(s):gmatch("[^;]+") do local c = trim((part:gsub("%s+", " "))) if c ~= "" then out[#out + 1] = c end end return out end
-- dg.ctl.sendArg("invoke lbolt at", matches[2]) -> sends "invoke lbolt at <what you typed>" function C.sendArg(prefix, arg) local cmd = trim(prefix .. " " .. (arg or "")) C.send(cmd) end
-- dg.ctl.sendDual("health", "invoke heal", matches[2]) -> no target: send("health"); with a target: sendArg("invoke heal", target) function C.sendDual(noargCmd, argPrefix, arg) arg = trim(arg or "") if arg ~= "" then C.sendArg(argPrefix, arg) else C.send(noargCmd) end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- highlights (unchanged mechanics; rules live in the highlights script) --------------------------------------------------------------------------- function C.hlLine(rgbName) local rgb = C.rgb[rgbName] or rgbName selectCurrentLine() setFgColor(unpack(rgb)) deselect() resetFormat() end
local function isWordChar(ch) return ch ~= "" and ch:match("[%w_]") ~= nil end
function C.hlWords(list, rgbName, bound, exactCase) local rgb = C.rgb[rgbName] or rgbName local text = curLine() local low = exactCase and text or text:lower() for _, w in ipairs(list) do local wl = exactCase and w or w:lower() local init = 1 while true do local s, e = low:find(wl, init, true) if not s then break end local okL = (not bound) or not isWordChar(low:sub(s - 1, s - 1)) local okR = (not bound) or not isWordChar(low:sub(e + 1, e + 1)) if okL and okR then selectSection(s - 1, e - s + 1) setFgColor(unpack(rgb)) end init = e + 1 end end deselect() resetFormat() end
function C.gate(h) local alts = {} for _, p in ipairs(h.words or h.lines or {}) do alts[#alts + 1] = glob(p) end for _, p in ipairs(h.rx or {}) do alts[#alts + 1] = p end local body = "(?:" .. table.concat(alts, "|") .. ")" if h.bound then body = "\\b" .. body .. "\\b" end return "(?i)" .. body end
function C.hlNames() for i = 2, #matches do local n = matches[i] if n and n ~= "" and n:lower() ~= "you" then C.hlWords({ n }, "key", true) end end end
-- Paint order (later paints over earlier): whole-line rules -> single words -> people lists -> targets function C.buildHighlights() C.kill("hl") local D = dg.ctlData if C.cfg.highlights ~= false then local function add(h) if not C.rgb[h.color] then C.warn("highlight '" .. tostring(h.name) .. "': unknown colour " .. tostring(h.color)); return end if h.words then C.trig("hl", C.gate(h), function() C.hlWords(h.words, h.color, h.bound) end) else C.trig("hl", C.gate(h), function() C.hlLine(h.color) end) end end for _, h in ipairs(D.highlights or {}) do if not h.words then add(h) end end for _, h in ipairs(D.highlights or {}) do if h.words then add(h) end end for _, g in ipairs(D.names or {}) do if not C.rgb[g.color] then C.warn("names '" .. tostring(g.label) .. "': unknown colour " .. tostring(g.color)) elseif #(g.names or {}) > 0 then local alts = {} for _, n in ipairs(g.names) do alts[#alts + 1] = reEsc(n) end C.trig("hl", "\\b(?:" .. table.concat(alts, "|") .. ")\\b", function() C.hlWords(g.names, g.color, true, true) end) end end -- disguises: your disguisable characters, the names they are wearing now, and your standing list local dn = C.disguiseNames() local dcol = (D.disguise and D.disguise.color) or "move" if #dn > 0 and C.rgb[dcol] then local alts = {} for _, n in ipairs(dn) do alts[#alts + 1] = reEsc(n) end C.trig("hl", "\\b(?:" .. table.concat(alts, "|") .. ")\\b", function() C.hlWords(dn, dcol, true, true) end) end end C.setTarget(1, C.targets[1] or "") C.setTarget(2, C.targets[2] or "") C.buildTemp() -- last, so temporary highlights paint over everything else end
function C.setTarget(slot, name) C.targets[slot] = trim(name) C.kill("target") for _, t in pairs(C.targets) do local tok = t:match("(%S+)$") if tok then C.trig("target", "(?i)\\b(" .. reEsc(tok) .. "\\w*)", function() C.hlWords({ matches[2] }, "alert", false) end) end end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- disguises (data lives in the highlights script: dg.ctlData.disguise) --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Ask the game who we are disguised as, once per character per session. The reply ("You are -- disguised as ...") is captured by the trigger in C.init. Needed after control is loaded or -- re-imported while you are already logged in: the login check has long since passed. function C.syncDisguise() if not C.char or C.disgAsked == C.char then return end C.disgAsked = C.char C.send("info disguise") end
function C.realName() return C.char and (C.char:sub(1, 1):upper() .. C.char:sub(2):lower()) or nil end
-- every name that should light up as a disguise: your disguisable characters, who each one is -- wearing right now, and the standing list of common disguises function C.disguiseNames() local d = (dg.ctlData and dg.ctlData.disguise) or {} local out, seen = {}, {} local function add(n) n = trim(n) if n ~= "" and not seen[n] then seen[n] = true; out[#out + 1] = n end end for char, dis in pairs(d.chars or {}) do if tostring(char):match("^%a") then add(char) end add(dis) end for _, n in ipairs(d.common or {}) do add(n) end return out end
-- called with the first name from "You are disguised as Ferrets Down, a Female San Elf Thief." function C.onDisguise(name) name = trim(name) if name == "" then return end local D = dg.ctlData D.disguise = D.disguise or {} D.disguise.chars = D.disguise.chars or {} local meChanged = C.me ~= name C.disgAsked = C.char C.me = name -- from here on "me" (lame, fame, heal me, {me} in loops) is the disguise -- paint it on this very line (the rebuilt highlight triggers only see the NEXT line) if C.cfg.highlights ~= false then C.hlWords({ name }, D.disguise.color or "move", true, true) end local who = C.realName() or "?" if D.disguise.chars[who] == name then if meChanged then C.say("me = " .. name .. " (disguise of " .. who .. ")") end return end D.disguise.chars[who] = name C.buildHighlights() C.say("disguise: " .. who .. " is " .. name .. " (me = " .. name .. ")") end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- disguise tools: disme FIELD VALUE / disme as PRESET -> keep trying until info disguise shows it -- ptdis FIELD VALUE / ptdis as PRESET -> keep disguising (training) until halt -- FIELD is name, class, sex or race. A PRESET is a whole disguise kept in the highlights data: -- dg.ctlData.disguise.presets = { ["tarvi andiyar"] = { name="Tarvi Andiyar", sex="male", race="...", class="..." } } --------------------------------------------------------------------------- function C.disguiseGoal(args) args = trim(args or "") local D = (dg.ctlData and dg.ctlData.disguise) or {} local preset = args:lower():match("^as%s+(.+)$") if preset then local P = D.presets and D.presets[trim(preset)] if not P then local names = {} for k in pairs(D.presets or {}) do names[#names + 1] = k end table.sort(names) C.warn("no disguise preset '" .. trim(preset) .. "'" .. (#names > 0 and (" (known: " .. table.concat(names, ", ") .. ")") or " (none saved yet)")) return nil end local f = {} for _, k in ipairs({ "name", "race", "sex", "class" }) do if P[k] and P[k] ~= "" then f[k] = P[k] end end return f end local f, v = args:match("^(%a+)%s+(.+)$") f = f and f:lower() if f == "name" or f == "class" or f == "sex" or f == "race" then return { [f] = trim(v) } end return nil end
function C.cmdDisguise(args, train) local cmd = train and "ptdis" or "disme" local fields = C.disguiseGoal(args) if not fields then if trim(args or "") == "" or not trim(args):lower():match("^as%s") then C.warn(cmd .. " name|class|sex|race VALUE e.g. " .. cmd .. " name Ferrets Down or " .. cmd .. " as PRESET") end return end C.disgGoal = { fields = fields } C.loopStart(train and "ptdis" or "disme", "") end function C.cmdDisme(args) C.cmdDisguise(args, false) end function C.cmdPtdis(args) C.cmdDisguise(args, true) end
function C.cmdDisg(args) args = trim(args):lower() local D = dg.ctlData D.disguise = D.disguise or {} D.disguise.chars = D.disguise.chars or {} if args == "clear" then local who = C.realName() if who then D.disguise.chars[who] = "" C.me = who C.buildHighlights() C.say("disguise cleared for " .. who .. " (me = " .. who .. ")") else C.warn("disg clear: no character known yet") end return end local keys = {} for k in pairs(D.disguise.chars) do keys[#keys + 1] = k end table.sort(keys) C.say("disguises (edit the list in the highlights script):") for _, k in ipairs(keys) do local v = D.disguise.chars[k] decho(" " .. k .. " = " .. ((v and v ~= "") and v or "-") .. "\n") end decho(" common: " .. (#(D.disguise.common or {}) > 0 and table.concat(D.disguise.common, ", ") or "-") .. "\n") end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- setme: say who "me" is for lame / heal me / trans me / the {me} in loop patterns. -- A real function as well as an alias, so triggers can call setme("Name") directly. -- It changes the name only; the archetype (class) stays as detected, unless the name is a -- character listed in the loops script, in which case it is treated as a full character switch. --------------------------------------------------------------------------- function C.setMe(name) name = trim(name) local D = dg.ctlData or {} if name == "" then local real = C.realName() C.say("me = " .. (C.me or "?") .. ((real and C.me ~= real) and (" (disguise; real char: " .. real .. ")") or "") .. " archetype: " .. (C.class or "?") .. " (setme NAME to change, setme reset to go back)") return end if name:lower() == "reset" then if C.char then C.me = C.realName() end C.say("me = " .. (C.me or "?")) return end if D.chars and D.chars[name:lower()] then C.setChar(name) return end C.me = name C.say("me = " .. name .. " (archetype stays " .. (C.class or "?") .. ")") end
function setme(name) return dg.ctl.setMe(name) end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- temporary highlights: tl WORD add remtl WORD remove cltl clear tl list -- The list is dg.ctlData.tempHL (also editable in the highlights script). --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Temporary highlights have to beat DGHud's colours. DGHud paints each line from its own -- catch-all trigger, and whichever trigger was created LAST paints last -- which flips if the -- HUD starts after control or is reloaded. So paint now, and again a moment later (a 0-second -- timer runs after every trigger has finished with the line), going back to the line by number. function C.paintTemp(n, text) local words = {} for _, w in ipairs((dg.ctlData and dg.ctlData.tempHL) or {}) do w = trim(w) if w ~= "" then words[#words + 1] = w end end if #words == 0 or not n then return end local cur, col = getLineNumber(), getColumnNumber() if moveCursor(0, n) and getCurrentLine() == text then C.hlWords(words, "temp", false) end moveCursor(col, cur) end
function C.buildTemp() C.kill("tl") local alts, words = {}, {} for _, w in ipairs((dg.ctlData and dg.ctlData.tempHL) or {}) do w = trim(w) if w ~= "" then alts[#alts + 1] = reEsc(w); words[#words + 1] = w end end if #alts == 0 then return end C.trig("tl", "(?i)(?:" .. table.concat(alts, "|") .. ")", function() C.hlWords(words, "temp", false) local n = getLineNumber and getLineNumber() if n then local text = getCurrentLine() tempTimer(0, function() pcall(C.paintTemp, n, text) end) end end) end
local function tlShow() local list = dg.ctlData.tempHL if #list == 0 then C.say("temp highlights: none (tl WORD to add)") else C.say("temp highlights: " .. table.concat(list, ", ")) end end
function C.cmdTL(args) args = trim(args) local D = dg.ctlData D.tempHL = D.tempHL or {} if args == "" then tlShow(); return end local low = args:lower() for _, w in ipairs(D.tempHL) do if w:lower() == low then C.say("already on the list: " .. w); return end end D.tempHL[#D.tempHL + 1] = args C.buildTemp() C.say("tl + " .. args) end
function C.cmdRemTL(args) args = trim(args) local D = dg.ctlData D.tempHL = D.tempHL or {} if args == "" then tlShow(); return end local low, kept, gone = args:lower(), {}, false for _, w in ipairs(D.tempHL) do if w:lower() == low then gone = true else kept[#kept + 1] = w end end D.tempHL = kept C.buildTemp() C.say(gone and ("tl - " .. args) or ("not on the list: " .. args)) end
function C.cmdClTL() dg.ctlData.tempHL = {} C.buildTemp() C.say("temp highlights cleared") end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Thoughts / Arrivals windows --------------------------------------------------------------------------- C.wins = C.wins or {} function C.hudInstalled() return type(DGHUD) == "table" end

function C.toWin(name, rgbName, text) local w = C.win(name) if not w then return end local rgb = C.rgb[rgbName] or rgbName decho(w, string.format("<%d,%d,%d>%s<r>\n", rgb[1], rgb[2], rgb[3], text)) end
local chatDefs = { { rx = "(\\w[\\w'-]*) thinks to you,(.*)$", label = "Private", color = "soft" }, { rx = "You pick up (\\w[\\w'-]*)'s mental link,(.*)$", label = "LINK", color = "soft" }, { rx = "You pick up (\\w[\\w'-]*)'s thoughts,(.*)$", label = "ESP", color = "soft" }, { rx = "(\\w[\\w'-]*) sends:(.*)$", label = "ELDER", color = "alert" }, }

(matches[3] or "")) if C.cfg.gagChat and C.panelsOn() then deleteLine() end end) end local arr = "^[\\s\\*]*(.+?)\\s+(just arrived in the world|has left the world unexpectedly|has left the world)\\." C.trig("chat", arr, function() local who, what = matches[2], matches[3] local verb = (what:find("unexpectedly") and "disco'd") or (what:find("left") and "left") or "arrived" C.toWin("Arrivals", "dim", who .. " " .. verb .. " at " .. os.date("%I:%M %p")) if C.cfg.gagArrivals and C.panelsOn() then deleteLine() else C.hlLine("dim") end end) end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- character detection: sets dg.ctl.me (display name) and dg.ctl.class (a key your aliases -- can check, e.g. "raptorian"/"kressa"/"tarvi"). See the loops script for the name/class -- lookup tables (dg.ctlData.chars, dg.ctlData.classKits). --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local function gmcpStatus() local st = gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Status if type(st) == "table" and type(st.name) == "string" and st.name ~= "" then return st end return nil end
local function classFor(name, gmcpClass) local D = dg.ctlData return (D.chars and D.chars[name:lower()]) or (gmcpClass and D.classKits and D.classKits[gmcpClass:lower()]) or name:lower() end
function C.setChar(name) local st = gmcpStatus() C.gmcpClass = (st and st.name:lower() == name:lower() and st.class) and trim(st.class) or nil C.char = name C.me = name:sub(1, 1):upper() .. name:sub(2):lower() C.class = classFor(name, C.gmcpClass) pcall(raiseEvent, "dgCharChanged", C.me) C.say("char: " .. C.me .. (C.gmcpClass and (" class: " .. C.gmcpClass) or "") .. " archetype: " .. (C.class or "?")) end
function C.onStatus() local st = gmcpStatus() if not st then return end if C.char and C.char:lower() == st.name:lower() then return end C.setChar(st.name) tempTimer(2, function() C.syncDisguise() end) end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- loop engine ("do X until it's dead or gone") -- dg.ctlLoops[name] = { start=.., rules={{pattern,cmd}...}, stop={..}, target=false, qc=true } -- or, when the same loop name means something different per character: -- dg.ctlLoops[name] = { by_class = { raptorian = {...}, kressa = {...} } } -- {t} = current target, {me} = your character name in a pattern/command; '*' = wildcard. -- Loops that need memory (pthide) can: use a function instead of a command string in a rule or -- in `start`; add `onStop = function() ... end` (runs on halt/F4/done, e.g. to cancel timers); -- and be written as `make = function() ... return def end`, called fresh on every start. --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local function subst(s, t) s = s:gsub("{t}", function() return t or "" end) s = s:gsub("{me}", function() return C.me or "" end) -- the name you are going by (disguise if any) s = s:gsub("{char}", function() return C.realName() or "" end) -- the real character, always return s end
-- Regex for a game-text pattern. {me} in a PATTERN matches the name you are going by, or your real -- name, each optionally followed by a surname -- the game's wording while disguised can't be -- assumed ("Ferrets's", "Ferrets Down's", "Kressa's" all match). function C.meRx() local names, seen = {}, {} for _, n in ipairs({ C.me or "", C.realName() or "" }) do n = trim(n) if n ~= "" and not seen[n:lower()] then seen[n:lower()] = true; names[#names + 1] = reEsc(n) end end if #names == 0 then return "" end return "(?:" .. table.concat(names, "|") .. ")(?: \\w+)?" end
function C.patRx(pat, t) pat = pat:gsub("{t}", function() return t or "" end) pat = pat:gsub("{char}", function() return C.realName() or "" end) local out, pos = {}, 1 while true do local a, b = pat:find("{me}", pos, true) if not a then out[#out + 1] = glob(pat:sub(pos)); break end out[#out + 1] = glob(pat:sub(pos, a - 1)) out[#out + 1] = C.meRx() pos = b + 1 end return table.concat(out) end
function C.loopDef(name) local L = dg.ctlLoops and dg.ctlLoops[name] if L and L.make then L = L.make() end -- factory: builds a fresh def (with its own state) on every start if L and L.by_class then local byClass = L.by_class[C.class] if not byClass then C.warn(name .. ": no version of this loop for '" .. (C.class or "?") .. "' yet -- add one under " .. name .. " (by_class) in the loops script, or map this character to an existing archetype in D.chars") end return byClass end return L end
function C.loopStop(reason, cmd) local cur = C.loopCur C.kill("loop") C.loopCur = nil if cur and cur.onStop then pcall(cur.onStop) end if cur then if cmd and cmd ~= "" then C.sendAll(C.split(cmd)) end C.say("loop off: " .. cur.name .. (reason and (" (" .. reason .. ")") or "")) end end
function C.halt() C.loopStop("halt") C.send("q c") end
function C.loopStart(name, args) local L = C.loopDef(name) if not L then return end args = trim(args or "")
local t = nil if L.target ~= false then t = (args ~= "") and args or C.lastTarget if not t or t == "" then C.warn(name .. ": needs a target, e.g. " .. name .. " orc"); return end C.lastTarget = t C.setTarget(1, t) end
C.loopStop() C.loopCur = { name = name, target = t, onStop = L.onStop }
for _, r in ipairs(L.rules or {}) do local rx = "(?i)" .. C.patRx(r[1], t) local cmd = r[2] C.trig("loop", rx, function() if type(cmd) == "function" then cmd(t) else C.sendAll(C.split(subst(cmd, t))) end end) end
local stops = {} if L.target ~= false then for _, s in ipairs(dg.ctlStops or {}) do stops[#stops + 1] = s end end for _, s in ipairs(L.stop or {}) do stops[#stops + 1] = s end for _, s in ipairs(stops) do local pat, cmd = s, nil if type(s) == "table" then pat, cmd = s[1], s[2] end C.trig("loop", "(?i)" .. C.patRx(pat, t), function() C.loopStop("done", cmd) end) end
if L.qc then C.send("q c") end if type(L.start) == "function" then L.start(t) else C.sendAll(C.split(subst(L.start or "", t))) end C.say("loop on: " .. name .. (t and (" vs " .. t) or "") .. " (halt / F4 to stop)") end

(C.targets[1] or "-") .. " t2: " .. (C.targets[2] or "-")) else C.setTarget(1, args) end end

function C.cmdCfg(args) local k, v = args:match("^(%S+)%s+(%S+)$") if not k then local keys = {} for kk, vv in pairs(C.cfg) do keys[#keys + 1] = kk .. "=" .. tostring(vv) end table.sort(keys) C.say("cfg: " .. table.concat(keys, " ") .. " (dgcfg KEY on|off|auto|VALUE)") return end if C.cfg[k] == nil then C.warn("unknown cfg key: " .. k); return end if v == "on" then v = true elseif v == "off" then v = false end C.cfg[k] = v if k == "highlights" then C.buildHighlights() end C.say(k .. " = " .. tostring(v)) end
function C.cmdStatus() C.say("DG Control " .. C.version .. " char: " .. (C.me or "?") .. " archetype: " .. (C.class or "?") .. " loop: " .. (C.loopCur and C.loopCur.name or "none")) decho("<255,255,85>mode:<r> HUD " .. (C.hudInstalled() and "detected" or "not detected") .. ", floating windows " .. (C.panelsOn() and "on" or "off") .. ", highlights " .. (C.cfg.highlights == false and "off" or "on") .. "\n") end
